object OutputFormat {
  private val TypeField = "type"
  private val PropertiesField = "properties"
  private val AdditionalPropertiesField = "additionalProperties"
  private val ObjectType = "object"
  private val TextType = "text"
  private val JsonObjectType = "json_object"
  private val JsonSchemaType = "json_schema"

val isObjectType = obj.value.get(TypeField).contains(ujson.Str(ObjectType))
      val hasProperties = obj.value.contains(PropertiesField)
      val hasAdditionalProperties = obj.value.contains(AdditionalPropertiesField)

case Text       => ujson.Obj(TypeField -> TextType)
        case JsonObject => ujson.Obj(TypeField -> JsonObjectType)
        case js: JsonSchema =>
          val baseJson = SnakePickle.writeJs(js)
          val objWithType = baseJson.obj.clone()
          objWithType(TypeField) = JsonSchemaType
          objWithType
      },
      { obj =>
        obj.obj.get(TypeField) match {
          case Some(ujson.Str(TextType))       => Text
          case Some(ujson.Str(JsonObjectType)) => JsonObject
          case Some(ujson.Str(JsonSchemaType)) => SnakePickle.read[JsonSchema](obj)
          case _                               => throw new Exception(s"Unknown OutputFormat: $obj")
        }
